title: Set up #council for PERMAFLEET
description: Gives a member org's officers a private #council channel to settle PERMAFLEET alliance votes. goon.vc's bot creates it, or the server's own channel is used.

welcome.say: Hi {{user.name}}! Every PERMAFLEET member org keeps a private **#council** channel, where its officers settle alliance votes before the org casts its one vote. Let's set one up on **{{context.guildName}}**.

channel.say: Should goon.vc's bot create #council, or is there a channel on **{{context.guildName}}** for it already?

roles.say: Who may see #council? Pick your officers' and Org Stewards' roles. Nobody else on **{{context.guildName}}** will see it; goon.vc's bot keeps access too.

permissions.say:
To create #council, goon.vc's bot needs **Manage Channels**, plus the permissions it gives your roles there. Missing on **{{context.guildName}}** right now: {{context.channelMissing}}.
Grant them with this link (it updates the bot if it's already in your server), then press Continue: {{context.channelInviteUrl}}

summary.say:
Here's the plan for **{{context.guildName}}**:
- Create a private #council
- Category: {{labels.category|none, top of the channel list}}
- Who can see it: {{labels.roles}}, and goon.vc's bot

Go ahead?

existing.say:
I'll use {{labels.channel}} as #council on **{{context.guildName}}** and leave its permissions as they are. Make sure only your officers can see it.

Go ahead?

complete.say: {{labels.result}} Your officers settle PERMAFLEET alliance votes there. Run `/goon council` again any time.

cancelled.say: Nothing changed. Run `/goon council` in your server to start again.
